rootCause: Split-brain auth: query param key mismatch (extension sends 'token', backend SPA reads 'sso_token') + 3 unsynced token stores (SecretStorage/cachedToken, localStorage.admin_token, URL bridge).
chosenFix: Single source of truth: extension host owns token, deliver into SPA via consistent postMessage token_refreshed channel; SPA listener writes localStorage.admin_token + flips loggedIn for both initial load and silent refresh.

requirements.reason: Bug fix — root cause pre-investigated by context-gatherer
